title: The garage, iii
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Wednesday. The corkboard rehung. Six years of pins, moved in one piece. One thing falls off in transit: the yearbook photo. He pins it back, lower.

panels.composition: WOOD carrying the corkboard in through the garage door, whole, everything still pinned. BARNABY underfoot.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man carrying a large corkboard covered in pinned papers through a garage door with a small dog underfoot

panels.composition: One item sliding off the bottom edge: the yearbook photo. MOST LIKELY TO WIN A PULITZER. Face down on the concrete.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a small yearbook photo sliding off a corkboard's edge and landing face down on a concrete floor
image.notes: The 1998 photo (objects.md corkboard). The caption text is not visible; it's face down.

panels.composition: The corkboard on the garage wall. Wood picking up the photo. Looking at it. The dog looking at him.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man picking up a small photo from a garage floor beneath a newly hung corkboard while a dog watches

panels.composition: The photo pinned back — at the bottom corner, lowest of everything. Where it can't fall far.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a corkboard's bottom corner with a small yearbook photo pinned there beneath everything else, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: The Pulitzer photo falls. Pinned back, lowest.
